newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks gain by close, volume up.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks gain by close, volume up.

text.p: Dhaka stocks, helped by food and fuel scrips, ended stronger amid higher volume, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index rose 17.4 points to 1,174.19 on turnover of 161 million taka. Of the 134 issues traded, 72 ended higher, 53 closed lower and nine remained unchanged. BOC Bangladesh Ltd gained 36.19 taka at 239.07 on a volume of 50,800. Beximco Fisheries rose 17.53 to 213.48 and Beixmco Synthetics fell 2.34 to 179.04.
Brokers said the rIse reflected the way investors were encouraged by the government's fresh initiative to boost the capital market.
